items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Marsalis -- [Winton, son of Ellis Marsalis, pianist]

ctx.x: Let me as you this--just to share some information with you in terms of like a lot of the things that I've been involved with in the last year and a half. Doing some things for the National Endowment ...I've been able to do some traveling to a lot of places and one of the things that I found that was very amazing to me and was an eye opener, was that, there is a lot of black talent out there, in differents parts of the country that for some reason or another is not being hooked up; is not getting the visibility.…
Marsalis -- [Winton, son of Ellis Marsalis, pianist]

Marsalis, . yeah. And his brother, the saxophonist, and these are like just a couple places that I know. There's a lot of talent out there. It seems you know, part of what's got to happen is some kind of network, has got to be built up, you know, to draw some of these people out of these areas so they know what's happening and then if they--I'm finding that they are out there
